title: implementer-reviewer-pairings
description: Defines which reviewer follows which implementer in the post-implementation chain. Default rule derives from viv-routing; explicit overrides go in 'overrides'. See ADR-003.

default_rule.description: from-routing-table: pair implementer→reviewer using routing-table.json (route.implementer paired with route.reviewer). explicit-only: only use overrides; no derivation.

overrides.description: Explicit overrides. An entry here takes precedence over default_rule for the matching implementer.
